items.title: Audit all 193 git child-process call sites and reroute the unrouted ones through resolveGitCwd
items.context: Get the live list via `git grep -nE "(execFileSync|spawnSync|execSync)\(['\"']git['\"']" -- 'packages/**/*.ts'`. For each site, determine the cwd source: ALREADY routed via resolveGitCwd / resolveStorySignedWorkspace / equivalent — keep as-is. Passing projectRoot/root/metadataRoot bare — REROUTE: call resolveGitCwd at the source (or accept a resolved cwd from caller) and pass it. Be careful NOT to break the 3 ad-hoc helpers (lab.ts runGit, cli-engine.ts runGitNoThrow, declared-artifact-commit-check.ts runGit) — keep them, but ensure their CALLERS use resolveGitCwd. The two existing smokes (gitroot-cwd-routing-smoke, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd-smoke) must continue to pass. After: `npm run build` exit 0; `npm run test:e2e` ALL PASS; `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-routing` exit 0; `npm run test:bare-gate-gitroot-cwd` exit 0; wrapper-root fixture tests pass.
items.userSees: Every git call site uses a cwd obtained from resolveGitCwd (or an existing helper that itself takes a resolved cwd); both existing wrapper-root smokes still pass; build + e2e green.

items.title: Add the grep-contract smoke test that fails on any bare-projectRoot git call
items.context: Create packages/main/src/tasks/gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts that runs the canonical grep across `packages/**/*.ts` looking for `(execFileSync|spawnSync|execSync)\(['\"']git['\"']` and inspects each hit. The smoke FAILS if any hit's cwd argument is a bare projectRoot/root/metadataRoot identifier or string literal not sourced from resolveGitCwd. An allowlist file (or inline whitelist) is supported for the resolveGitCwd helper itself and the 3 existing helper wrappers (lab.ts runGit / cli-engine.ts runGitNoThrow / declared-artifact-commit-check.ts runGit) — any other site fails the contract. Register `test:gitroot-cwd-contract` script in root package.json and packages/main/package.json. Add an entry to the main e2e suite or run it in CI so the contract gate runs on every PR. After: `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` passes on current state (after CHK-001 reroutes); intentionally introducing a regression (add `execFileSync('git',['status'],{cwd:projectRoot})` in a test fixture file) makes the smoke FAIL with a clear error pointing at the bad site.
items.userSees: `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` passes on HEAD; running it after a deliberate regression injection fails with a clear pointer to the offending file:line and a remediation message naming resolveGitCwd.
